4939.title: ACP bridge loses recovery state when its agent exits
4939.rootCauseOneLine: Unexpected agent exit deletes ACP reconstruction state and clears active-prompt state before failed-turn emission, preventing recovery.
4939.proposedFix: Retain established exited sessions, emit interrupted-turn failure before clearing state, and invoke existing session/load rebuild on the next turn.
4939.caveats: Verified with the repository fixture and real runtime, not the external macOS agent; the host provider_process_exited marker is a distinct outer-process boundary.
